scanNote:
GRAMMAR 54-BET. Unit 12 — qiyoslash mashqlari va 1-12-unitlar takrori.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 7-mashq (10 ta variant), 8-mashq (8 ta xatoni tuzatish), 9-mashq (4 dialog, 21 bo'shliq) — jami 39 ta javob.

⚠ 7-MAShQ — QAYSI DARAJA KERAKLIGINI GAP O'ZI AYTADI:
  'THAN' bor    → QIYOSIY daraja (shorter, more interesting, heavier)
  'IN his class/family/town' bor → ORTTIRMA daraja (the best, the tallest, the most popular)
  'A VERY ...' bor → ODDIY shakl (pretty, expensive, exciting, famous)
  ⚠ Ya'ni javobni topish uchun sifatning o'ziga emas, ATROFIDAGI so'zlarga qarang.

⚠ 8-MAShQ — BESh XIL XATO TURI:
  1) noto'g'ri daraja: 'fastest than' → FASTER (than bilan qiyosiy)
  2) daraja umuman qo'yilmagan: 'short than' → SHORTER; 'old than' → OLDER
  3) imlo: 'prettyer' → PRETTIER ('-y' → '-ier')
  4) 'much' qiyosiy bilan keladi: 'much smallest than' → much SMALLER
  5) 'the more' XATO: ikki bo'g'inli sifatning orttirma darajasi 'THE MOST'
  6) 'very' bilan daraja bo'lmaydi: 'a very nicer dress' → a very NICE dress

⚠ 9-MAShQ — TO'RT DIALOG, TO'RT ZAMON:
  1-dialog — o'tmish (Were/wasn't/went/happened/fell/broke)
  2-dialog — hozirgi davomli + kelasi (Are you going / will rain)
  3-dialog — hozirgi (Can I have / are / is it / is)
  4-dialog — o'tmish (was/went/did you go/Did you have)
  ⚠ 3-dialogdagi 'Here you ARE' — do'konda narsa uzatishda ishlatiladigan barqaror ibora.

⚠ FOYDALI TASDIQ: 9-mashqning 4-dialogida restoran nomi 'PIERRE'S' deb TO'G'RI yozilgan — urg'u belgisiz. Coursebook 72-73-betlarda esa xuddi shu ism 'Pièrre' deb noto'g'ri bosilgan. Demak xato faqat o'sha ikki betda.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the adjectives in the list to write six sentences about your family members, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi sifatlardan foydalanib oila a'zolaringiz haqida oltita gap yozing, namunalardagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN OLTI SIFAT:
  old, tall, patient, short, good, friendly

KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:
  'My father is TALLER THAN my mother.'
     → QIYOSIY daraja + THAN (ikki odam)
  'My brother is THE TALLEST IN our family.'
     → ORTTIRMA daraja + IN (butun oila)

  Kitob ataylab IKKALA qolipni ham ko'rsatgan —
  siz ham ikkalasidan foydalanishingiz kerak.


HAR SIFATNING SHAKLLARI:
  old      →  older      /  the oldest
  tall     →  taller     /  the tallest
  patient  →  MORE patient / THE MOST patient
                              (2 bo'g'in, '-y' yo'q)
  short    →  shorter    /  the shortest
  good     →  BETTER     /  THE BEST  (noto'g'ri!)
  friendly →  friendlIER /  the friendlIEST  ('-y')


OLTI NAMUNA GAP (o'z oilangizga moslang):

  1  My father is older than my mother.
     (Otam onamdan katta.)

  2  My brother is the tallest in our family.
     (Akam oilamizdagi eng baland bo'yli.)

  3  My mother is more patient than my father.
     (Onam otamdan sabrliroq.)

  4  My sister is the shortest in our family.
     (Singlim oilamizdagi eng past bo'yli.)

  5  My grandmother is a better cook than my mother.
     (Buvim onamdan yaxshiroq oshpaz.)

  6  My cousin is the friendliest person in our
     family.
     (Amakivachcham oilamizdagi eng do'stona odam.)


DIQQAT — 'GOOD' NOTO'G'RI SIFAT:
  'gooder' / 'the goodest' XATO.
  'BETTER' / 'THE BEST' to'g'ri.

DIQQAT — 'PATIENT' 2 BO'G'INLI, '-Y' YO'Q:
  → MORE patient ('patienter' XATO).
  'patient' = sabrli.
  DIQQAT: 'a patient' (ot) = bemor — boshqa so'z.

DIQQAT — 'FRIENDLY' '-Y' BILAN TUGAGAN:
  → friendlIER / the friendlIEST.
  '-ly' bilan tugasa ham bu SIFAT.


OILA A'ZOLARI LUG'ATI:
  father, mother, brother, sister,
  grandfather, grandmother,
  uncle (amaki/tog'a), aunt (amma/xola),
  cousin (amakivachcha/xolavachcha)

modelSentences.sentence: My father is taller than my mother.
modelSentences.uz: Otam onamdan baland bo'yli. (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA — QIYOSIY + THAN)

modelSentences.sentence: My brother is the tallest in our family.
modelSentences.uz: Akam oilamizdagi eng baland bo'yli. (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA — ORTTIRMA + IN)

modelSentences.sentence: My father is older than my mother.
My mother is more patient than my father.
modelSentences.uz: Onam otamdan sabrliroq. (2 bo'g'in, '-y' yo'q → MORE)

modelSentences.sentence: My sister is the shortest in our family.
modelSentences.uz: Singlim oilamizdagi eng past bo'yli. (1 bo'g'in → THE -EST)

modelSentences.sentence: My grandmother is a better cook than my mother.
modelSentences.uz: Buvim onamdan yaxshiroq oshpaz. (NOTO'G'RI sifat → BETTER)

modelSentences.sentence: My cousin is the friendliest person in our family.
modelSentences.uz: Amakivachcham oilamizdagi eng do'stona odam. ('-y' → THE -IEST)

exercises.explanationUz:
O'N BAND — har birida UCh variant:
  A — ODDIY shakl
  B — QIYOSIY daraja
  C — ORTTIRMA daraja

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  B  shorter          ('than' bor)
   2  C  the best         ('in his class')
   3  A  pretty           ('a ... girl' — qiyoslash yo'q)
   4  B  more interesting ('than' bor)
   5  A  expensive        ('very' bor)
   6  C  the tallest      ('in his family')
   7  A  exciting         ('very' bor)
   8  B  heavier          ('than' bor)
   9  A  famous           ('very' bor)
  10  C  the most popular ('in my town')


UCh KALIT BELGI — HAMMASI ShU:

  'THAN' bor              →  B (QIYOSIY)
     1, 4, 8-bandlar

  'IN ...' bor            →  C (ORTTIRMA)
     2, 6, 10-bandlar

  'VERY' bor yoki 'a/an'  →  A (ODDIY)
     3, 5, 7, 9-bandlar


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  U akasidan past bo'yli.
   2  Bill sinfidagi eng yaxshi o'quvchi.
   3  Syuzan chiroyli qiz.
   4  Nyu-York Mayamidan qiziqarliroq.
   5  Parij juda qimmat shahar.
   6  Nik oilasidagi eng baland bo'yli.
   7  'Independence Day' juda qiziqarli film.
   8  It sichqondan og'irroq.
   9  'The Roxy' — Bostondagi juda mashhur klub.
  10  'Anthony's' — mening shahrimdagi eng mashhur kafe.


ENG MUHIM — 3-BAND ALDAMChI:
  'Susan is a ...... girl.'
  Bu yerda hech kim bilan solishtirilmayapti va
  'the' ham yo'q — shunchaki TASVIR.
  → ODDIY shakl 'PRETTY'.
  'a prettier girl' ham grammatik jihatdan mumkin,
  lekin gapda 'than' yo'q → to'liq emas.
  'a the prettiest girl' XATO ('a' va 'the' birga
  kelmaydi).

DIQQAT — 9-BANDDA 'VERY' VA 'IN BOSTON' BIRGA:
  'The Roxy is a VERY ...... club IN BOSTON.'
  'in Boston' bor, lekin 'a very' ham bor →
  'a' artikli ORTTIRMA daraja bilan KELMAYDI
  ('a the most famous' XATO).
  → ODDIY shakl 'FAMOUS'.
  'in Boston' bu yerda shunchaki JOY ko'rsatadi.

DIQQAT — 10-BANDDA 'A' YO'Q:
  'Anthony's is ...... cafe in my town.'
  Bo'shliqdan oldin artikl YO'Q → 'the' javobning
  ichida bo'lishi kerak → C 'THE MOST POPULAR'.
  9-band bilan SOLIShTIRING: u yerda 'a very' bor edi.


ATOQLI OTLAR:
  Independence Day — 1996-yilgi amerikacha film
  The Roxy — Coursebook 83-betdagi maqolada
     eslatilgan klub (lekin u LA da; bu yerda Boston)
  Miami, Boston — AQSh shaharlari

items.whyUz:
B — 'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'short' — 1 bo'g'in → SHORTER.

items.textEn: 2  Bill is ............ student in his class.
items.whyUz:
C — 'IN his class' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'good' — NOTO'G'RI sifat → THE BEST.
Bo'shliqdan oldin artikl yo'q → 'the' javobda.

A — QIYOSLASH YO'Q, shunchaki TASVIR.
'than' ham, 'in ...' ham yo'q.
DIQQAT: bo'shliqdan oldin 'A' bor —
'a' va 'the' BIRGA kelmaydi, shuning uchun
C varianti ('the prettiest') MUMKIN EMAS.

B — 'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'interesting' — 4 bo'g'in → MORE INTERESTING.

A — 'VERY' bor → ODDIY shakl.
'very more expensive' XATO.
Grammar 52-betdagi 'Quite/Very/Too' qoidasi.

C — 'IN his family' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'tall' — 1 bo'g'in → THE TALLEST.
6-mashqdagi namuna bilan bir xil qolip.

items.textEn: 7  Independence Day is a very ............ film.
items.whyUz:
A — 'VERY' bor → ODDIY shakl.
5-band bilan bir xil qoida.
'Independence Day' — 1996-yilgi film.

items.textEn: 8  A dog is ............ than a mouse.
items.whyUz:
B — 'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'heavy' — '-y' tushadi → HEAVIER.
Grammar 52-betdagi 'Use' qutisida ham
'An elephant is much heavier than a mouse' bor edi.

items.textEn: 9  The Roxy is a very ............ club in Boston.
items.whyUz:
A — 'A VERY' bor → ODDIY shakl.
DIQQAT: 'in Boston' bor, lekin 'A' artikli ham bor.
'a the most famous' XATO.
Bu yerda 'in Boston' shunchaki JOY ko'rsatadi,
orttirma daraja belgisi EMAS.
10-band bilan SOLISHTIRING.

items.textEn: 10  Anthony's is ............ cafe in my town.
items.whyUz:
C — 'IN my town' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
DIQQAT: 9-banddan farqli, bu yerda bo'shliqdan
oldin 'a very' YO'Q → 'the' javobning ichida.
'popular' — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST POPULAR.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  My new car is ~~fastest~~ than my old one.
                        FASTER

  'than' bor → QIYOSIY daraja kerak edi,
  lekin ORTTIRMA yozilgan.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  fastest   →  FASTER            (NAMUNA)
  2  short     →  SHORTER
  3  prettyer  →  PRETTIER
  4  smallest  →  SMALLER
  5  the fascinating → THE MOST FASCINATING
  6  the more famous → THE MOST FAMOUS
  7  old       →  OLDER
  8  a very nicer → A VERY NICE


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI (tuzatilgan holda):
  1  Mening yangi mashinam eskisidan tezroq.
  2  Aleks Tomdan past bo'yli.
  3  U opasidan chiroyliroq.
  4  Edinburg Londondan ancha kichikroq.
  5  Misr eng maftunkor mamlakat.
  6  Eyfel minorasi Fransiyadagi eng mashhur minora.
  7  Rim Venesiyadan eskiroqmi?
  8  Bu juda chiroyli ko'ylak.


HAR BIR XATONING TURI:

  1  ORTTIRMA o'rniga QIYOSIY kerak
     'than' bor → 'faster'.

  2  ODDIY shakl o'rniga QIYOSIY kerak
     'than' bor → 'shorter'.

  3  YOZILISh XATOSI
     'pretty' → '-y' TUShADI → 'prettIER'
     ('prettyer' XATO).

  4  ORTTIRMA o'rniga QIYOSIY kerak
     'much' va 'than' bor →
     'much SMALLER than'.
     DIQQAT: 'much' faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan.

  5  'THE' bor, lekin sifat ODDIY shaklda
     → ORTTIRMA kerak:
     'fascinating' — 4 bo'g'in →
     'THE MOST FASCINATING'.

  6  'MORE' o'rniga 'MOST' kerak
     'the ... tower IN France' → ORTTIRMA.
     'the MORE famous' XATO →
     'the MOST famous'.
     Bu — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

  7  ODDIY shakl o'rniga QIYOSIY kerak
     'than' bor → 'older'.

  8  QIYOSIY o'rniga ODDIY shakl kerak
     'a VERY' bor → sifat O'ZGARMAYDI:
     'a very NICE dress'.
     'a very nicer' XATO.


XATOLARNING IKKI ASOSIY TURI:

  A) NOTO'G'RI DARAJA tanlangan
     (1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8-bandlar)
     Kalit so'zga qarang:
        than → QIYOSIY
        the ... in/of → ORTTIRMA
        very/quite → ODDIY

  B) NOTO'G'RI YOZILGAN
     (3-band: 'prettyer' → 'prettier')

items.textEn: 1  My new car is FASTEST than my old one.
items.whyUz:
NAMUNA.
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja kerak.
'fast' — 1 bo'g'in → FASTER.
ORTTIRMA ('fastest') 'than' bilan ISHLATILMAYDI.

'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja kerak,
lekin ODDIY shakl yozilgan.
'short' — 1 bo'g'in → SHORTER.

Daraja TO'G'RI (qiyosiy), lekin YOZILIShI xato.
'pretty' — '-y' TUShADI, '-IER' qo'shiladi:
  pretty → prett + IER → PRETTIER
'prettyer' XATO.

items.textEn: 4  Edinburgh is much SMALLEST than London.
items.whyUz:
'MUCH' va 'THAN' — ikkalasi ham QIYOSIY
darajani talab qiladi.
'small' — 1 bo'g'in → SMALLER.
'much smallest' XATO — 'much' faqat qiyosiy
daraja bilan (Grammar 52-bet).

'THE' bor → ORTTIRMA daraja kerak.
'fascinating' — 4 bo'g'in → THE MOST FASCINATING.
'the fascinating country' — grammatik jihatdan
to'liq emas ('the' orttirma darajani talab qiladi).

items.textEn: 6  The Eiffel Tower is THE MORE FAMOUS tower in France.
items.whyUz:
'THE ... IN France' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'the MORE' XATO → 'the MOST'.
BU ENG KO'P UCHRAYDIGAN XATO:
  MORE — qiyosiy daraja uchun
  THE MOST — orttirma daraja uchun
Eyfel minorasi — Parijdagi mashhur minora.

'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja kerak.
'old' — 1 bo'g'in → OLDER.
Rim va Venesiya — Coursebook 86-betdagi
16b-mashqdagi shaharlar.

items.textEn: 8  That is a very NICER dress.
items.whyUz:
'A VERY' bor → ODDIY shakl kerak.
'a very NICE dress'.
'a very nicer' XATO.
7-mashqning 5, 7, 9-bandlari bilan bir xil qoida.
DIQQAT: 'a' artikli ham qiyosiy/orttirma
darajaga to'sqinlik qiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. (Dialogue 1)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: WERE you at home last night?
  B: No, I WASN'T. I WENT to hospital.
  A: What HAPPENED?
  B: I FELL off my bicycle and BROKE my arm.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  A: Kecha kechqurun uydamiding?
  B: Yo'q, emasdim. Kasalxonaga bordim.
  A: Nima bo'ldi?
  B: Velosipeddan yiqilib, qo'limni sindirdim.


ZAMON: PAST SIMPLE — hammasi.
  Belgisi: 'LAST NIGHT'.


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ:

  1) '...... (be) you at home last night?'
     'be' fe'lining SO'ROQ shakli:
     WERE + you + ... ?
     'did' KERAK EMAS — 'be' fe'li o'zi
     oldinga chiqadi.

  2) 'No, I ...... (not/be).'
     QISQA javob: 'No, I WASN'T.'
     'I' → was → wasn't.
     DIQQAT: savolda 'were', javobda 'wasn't' —
     chunki savolda 'you' (siz), javobda 'I' (men).

  3) 'I ...... (go) to hospital.'
     go → WENT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
     DIQQAT: 'TO HOSPITAL' — artikl YO'Q
     (davolanish uchun borganda).
     'to the hospital' — binoga borganda
     (masalan, kimnidir ko'rgani).

  4) 'What ...... (happen)?'
     happen → HAPPENED (to'g'ri fe'l).
     DIQQAT: 'What' bu yerda EGA →
     'did' KERAK EMAS!
     'What DID happen?' XATO.
     Bu — Unit 11 (Workbook 46-bet) dagi
     EGA/TO'LDIRUVChI savollari qoidasi.

  5) 'I ...... (fall) off my bicycle'
     fall → FELL (noto'g'ri fe'l).
     'fall OFF' = ... dan yiqilmoq.

  6) 'and ...... (break) my arm'
     break → BROKE (noto'g'ri fe'l).
     'break one's arm' = qo'lini sindirmoq.


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
  be    → was / were
  go    → went
  fall  → fell
  break → broke

lines.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE SO'ROQ, 'be' fe'li bilan.
'you' → WERE.
'be' fe'li so'roqda O'ZI oldinga chiqadi —
'did' KERAK EMAS.
'last night' → o'tgan zamon.

QISQA JAVOB: 'No, I WASN'T.'
'I' → was → WASN'T.
DIQQAT: savolda 'were' (you), javobda
'wasn't' (I) — ega o'zgargani uchun.

go → WENT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
DIQQAT: 'TO HOSPITAL' — artikl YO'Q,
chunki davolanish uchun borilgan.
('to THE hospital' — binoga tashrif uchun.)

happen → HAPPENED (to'g'ri fe'l).
DIQQAT: 'What' EGA o'rnida turibdi →
'DID' KERAK EMAS.
'What DID happen?' XATO.
Bu — Unit 11 dagi ega/to'ldiruvchi savollari
qoidasi (Workbook 46-bet).

fall → FELL (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'fall OFF' = ... dan yiqilmoq (predlog OFF).

break → BROKE (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'break my arm' = qo'limni sindirmoq.
DIQQAT: 'and' dan keyin ega takrorlanmaydi
(I fell ... and [I] broke ...).

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. (Dialogue 2)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: ARE YOU GOING out?
  B: Yes, I AM.
  A: Where ARE YOU GOING?
  B: To the sports centre.
  A: Take an umbrella. I think it WILL RAIN.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  A: Tashqariga chiqyapsanmi?
  B: Ha.
  A: Qayerga ketyapsan?
  B: Sport markaziga.
  A: Soyabon ol. Menimcha yomg'ir yog'adi.


ZAMONLAR — IKKI XIL:

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS (1, 2, 3-bo'shliqlar)
     Hozir sodir bo'layotgan yoki
     REJALAShTIRILGAN yaqin kelajak.
     'Are you going out?' — hozir chiqyaptimi
     yoki chiqmoqchimi.

  WILL (4-bo'shliq)
     TAXMIN, oldindan REJA EMAS.
     'I THINK it WILL rain' —
     'I think' dan keyin DOIM 'will'.


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ:

  1) '...... (you/go) out?'
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS SO'ROQ:
     ARE + you + GOING?
     → 'ARE YOU GOING out?'

  2) 'Yes, I ...... (be).'
     QISQA JAVOB: 'Yes, I AM.'
     Present continuous savoliga qisqa javob
     faqat 'be' fe'li bilan beriladi
     ('Yes, I am going' emas).

  3) 'Where ...... (you/go)?'
     Yana PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
     → 'Where ARE YOU GOING?'

  4) 'I think it ...... (rain).'
     → 'it WILL RAIN'
     'I think' + WILL — TAXMIN qolipi.
     DIQQAT: 'I think it is raining' bo'lsa —
     hozir yog'ayotgan bo'lardi. Lekin gapda
     'Take an umbrella' bor → hali yog'magan,
     KELAJAK haqida gap.


DIQQAT — 'GOING TO' EMAS, 'GOING':
  'Are you going OUT?' — bu yerda 'go out' =
  tashqariga chiqmoq (turg'un ibora).
  'be going to' (kelajak qolipi) BOShQA narsa.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to go out       = tashqariga chiqmoq
  a sports centre = sport markazi
  an umbrella     = soyabon
  to rain         = yomg'ir yog'moq

lines.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS SO'ROQ:
ARE + you + GOING.
Hozir sodir bo'layotgan yoki rejalashtirilgan
yaqin kelajak.
'go out' = tashqariga chiqmoq.

QISQA JAVOB: 'Yes, I AM.'
Present continuous savoliga faqat 'be' fe'li
bilan javob beriladi.
'Yes, I am going' — to'liq, lekin qisqa javobda
faqat 'am'.

PRESENT CONTINUOUS SO'ROQ:
'Where ARE YOU GOING?'
Savol so'zi ('Where') eng oldinda,
keyin 'are you going'.

lines.textEn: Take an umbrella. I think it 4) ............ (rain).
lines.whyUz:
'I THINK' + WILL — TAXMIN qolipi.
'it WILL RAIN' = yomg'ir yog'adi (menimcha).
DIQQAT: 'is raining' bo'lsa — hozir yog'ayotgan
bo'lardi. Lekin 'Take an umbrella' aytilgan →
hali yog'magan, KELAJAK haqida gap.
'will' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. (Dialogue 3)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: CAN I HAVE a cheese sandwich, please?
  B: Yes, here you ARE.
  A: Thanks. How much IS IT?
  B: It IS one pound thirty. Anything else?
  A: No, thanks.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  A: Pishloqli buterbrod bering, iltimos.
  B: Ha, mana.
  A: Rahmat. Qancha turadi?
  B: Bir funt o'ttiz. Boshqa narsa kerakmi?
  A: Yo'q, rahmat.


ZAMON: HOZIRGI — do'kon/kafedagi suhbat.


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ:

  1) '...... (I/have) a cheese sandwich, please?'
     → 'CAN I HAVE a cheese sandwich, please?'

     DIQQAT: bu — buyurtma berish/so'rashning
     standart iborasi.
     'CAN I HAVE ...?' = ... bering, iltimos.
     'May I have ...?' ham to'g'ri, lekin
     rasmiyroq.
     'I have a sandwich, please?' — grammatik
     jihatdan NOTO'G'RI, shuning uchun 'can'
     kerak.

  2) 'Yes, here you ...... (be).'
     → 'Here you ARE.'
     Bu — TURG'UN IBORA: 'Mana' (biror narsani
     uzatganda aytiladi).
     'you' → ARE.
     'Here you go' ham aytiladi (norasmiy).

  3) 'How much ...... (it/be)?'
     → 'How much IS IT?'
     Narx so'rashning standart savoli.
     'it' → IS.
     SO'ROQ tartibi: IS + IT.

  4) 'It ...... (be) one pound thirty.'
     → 'It IS one pound thirty.'
     ('It's one pound thirty.')
     'one pound thirty' = 1 funt 30 tiyin
     (£1.30).


DIQQAT — SO'ROQ VA TASDIQ TARTIBI:
  SAVOL:  'How much IS IT?'   (is + it)
  JAVOB:  'IT IS one pound thirty.' (it + is)
  Tartib TESKARI.


DO'KON IBORALARI:
  Can I have ...?   = ... bering, iltimos
  Here you are.     = Mana.
  How much is it?   = Qancha turadi?
  Anything else?    = Boshqa narsa kerakmi?
  No, thanks.       = Yo'q, rahmat.

  Bu iboralar Unit 8 ('Enjoy your Meal') da
  o'rganilgan edi.

lines.whyUz:
'CAN I HAVE ...?' — buyurtma berish/so'rashning
standart iborasi = '... bering, iltimos'.
DIQQAT: faqat 'I have a sandwich, please?'
grammatik jihatdan NOTO'G'RI — 'can' kerak.
'May I have ...?' ham to'g'ri, lekin rasmiyroq.
Unit 8 ('Enjoy your Meal') da o'rganilgan.

'HERE YOU ARE.' — TURG'UN IBORA:
'Mana' (biror narsani uzatganda).
'you' → ARE.
'Here you go' ham aytiladi (norasmiy).

'How much IS IT?' — narx so'rashning standart
savoli.
SO'ROQ tartibi: IS + IT (fe'l oldinda).
'it' → IS.

lines.textEn: It 4) ............ (be) one pound thirty. Anything else?
lines.whyUz:
'It IS one pound thirty.' ('It's ...')
TASDIQ tartibi: IT + IS (ega oldinda).
3-band bilan SOLISHTIRING — tartib TESKARI.
'one pound thirty' = £1.30.
'Anything else?' = Boshqa narsa kerakmi?

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. (Dialogue 4)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: When WAS the last time you WENT out for
     dinner?
  B: Last Saturday.
  A: Where DID YOU GO?
  B: To Pierre's, the new French restaurant.
  A: Who DID YOU GO with?
  B: I WENT with Terry and Sandra.
  A: DID YOU HAVE a good time?
  B: Yes, it WAS great.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  A: Oxirgi marta qachon kechki ovqatga
     chiqqan eding?
  B: O'tgan shanbada.
  A: Qayerga bording?
  B: 'Pierre's' ga — yangi fransuz restoraniga.
  A: Kim bilan bording?
  B: Terri va Sandra bilan bordim.
  A: Yaxshi vaqt o'tkazdingmi?
  B: Ha, ajoyib edi.


ZAMON: PAST SIMPLE — hammasi.
  Belgisi: 'the LAST TIME', 'LAST Saturday'.


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ:

  1) 'When ...... (be) the last time ...'
     → 'When WAS the last time ...?'
     'the last time' — BIRLIK → WAS.

  2) '... you ...... (go) out for dinner?'
     → 'you WENT out for dinner'
     DIQQAT: 'did' KERAK EMAS!
     Bu qism SAVOL emas — 'the last time' otini
     aniqlaydigan ergash gap.
     'the last time (WHEN) you WENT out'
     ('when' tushirib qoldirilgan).
     'you did go' XATO.

  3) 'Where ...... (you/go)?'
     → 'Where DID YOU GO?'
     Bu ESA to'liq SAVOL → 'did' KERAK.
     DID + you + GO (asosiy shakl).

  4) 'Who ...... (you/go) with?'
     → 'Who DID YOU GO with?'
     TO'LDIRUVChI savoli → 'did' KERAK.
     'with' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
     Unit 11 (Workbook 46-bet) qoidasi.

  5) 'I ...... (go) with Terry and Sandra.'
     → 'I WENT with ...'
     TASDIQ gap → 'did' YO'Q,
     fe'l O'TGAN shaklda: WENT.

  6) '...... (you/have) a good time?'
     → 'DID YOU HAVE a good time?'
     SAVOL → DID + you + HAVE (asosiy shakl).
     'Did you had' XATO.
     'have a good time' = yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq.

  7) 'Yes, it ...... (be) great.'
     → 'it WAS great.'
     'it' → WAS.


ENG MUHIM DARS — 2-BAND ALDAMChI:
  'When was the last time you ...... out?'

  Bu gapda IKKI qism bor:
     SAVOL:      'When was the last time ...?'
     ERGASh GAP: '... you WENT out for dinner'

  Savol qismi allaqachon 'was' bilan berilgan,
  shuning uchun ikkinchi qismda 'did' KERAK EMAS.

  SOLIShTIRING:
     'the last time you WENT out'   ✓ (ergash gap)
     'Where DID YOU GO?'            ✓ (to'liq savol)


'DID' QAChON KERAK — XULOSA:
  TO'LIQ savolda        →  DID + ega + asosiy fe'l
     (3, 4, 6-bandlar)
  TASDIQ gapda          →  'did' YO'Q, o'tgan shakl
     (5-band)
  ERGASh gapda          →  'did' YO'Q, o'tgan shakl
     (2-band)
  'BE' fe'li bilan      →  'did' YO'Q
     (1, 7-bandlar)

lines.whyUz:
'the last time' — BIRLIK → WAS.
'be' fe'li bilan savolda 'did' KERAK EMAS.

lines.hintUz: DIQQAT — bu SAVOL emas, ergash gap
lines.whyUz:
'did' KERAK EMAS!
Bu qism SAVOL emas — 'the last time' otini
aniqlaydigan ERGASH GAP:
'the last time (when) you WENT out'.
Savol qismi allaqachon 'When WAS ...?' bilan
berilgan.
go → WENT.
'you did go' XATO.

TO'LIQ SAVOL → 'did' KERAK.
DID + you + GO (ASOSIY shakl).
'did you went' XATO.
2-band bilan SOLISHTIRING — u yerda 'did' yo'q edi.

lines.textEn: To Pierre's, the new French restaurant.

lines.whyUz:
TO'LDIRUVCHI savoli ('kim BILAN') → 'did' KERAK.
DID + you + GO.
'with' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
Unit 11 (Workbook 46-bet, 14-mashq):
'Who did you go with?'

TASDIQ gap → 'did' YO'Q,
fe'l O'TGAN shaklda: WENT.

HA/YO'Q SAVOLI → DID + you + HAVE (asosiy shakl).
'Did you had' XATO.
'have a good time' = yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq.

'it' → WAS.
'be' fe'li — 'did' KERAK EMAS.
Coursebook 85-betdagi 15-mashq bilan bir xil
qolip: 'It was fantastic!'

patterns.formula: My [qarindosh] is [QIYOSIY] THAN my [qarindosh].   /   My [qarindosh] is THE [ORTTIRMA] IN our family.
patterns.exampleEn: My father is taller than my mother. My brother is the tallest in our family.
patterns.exampleUz: Otam onamdan baland bo'yli. Akam oilamizdagi eng baland bo'yli.
patterns.explanationUz:
6-mashqning ikki namunasi:
ikki odam → QIYOSIY + THAN,
butun oila → ORTTIRMA + IN.

patterns.exampleEn: Paris is a very expensive city. The Roxy is a very famous club in Boston.
patterns.exampleUz: Parij juda qimmat shahar. 'The Roxy' — Bostondagi juda mashhur klub.
patterns.explanationUz:
'a very' bo'lsa — sifat O'ZGARMAYDI.
'a' artikli va orttirma daraja BIRGA kelmaydi.

patterns.formula: Were you ... ?  —  No, I wasn't.   /   Did you ... ?  —  Yes, I did.
patterns.exampleEn: Were you at home last night? — No, I wasn't. Did you have a good time? — Yes, it was great.
patterns.exampleUz: Kecha kechqurun uydamiding? — Yo'q, emasdim. Yaxshi vaqt o'tkazdingmi? — Ha, ajoyib edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'be' fe'li bilan 'did' KERAK EMAS;
boshqa fe'llar bilan 'did' KERAK.

patterns.formula: the last time you + O'TGAN fe'l   (ERGASH gap — 'did' YO'Q)
patterns.exampleEn: When was the last time you went out for dinner?
patterns.exampleUz: Oxirgi marta qachon kechki ovqatga chiqqan eding?
patterns.explanationUz:
Savol qismi allaqachon 'When was ...?' bilan
berilgan → ikkinchi qismda 'did' KERAK EMAS.
'you did go' XATO.

patterns.formula: I think it WILL + ASOSIY fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: Take an umbrella. I think it will rain.
patterns.explanationUz:
'I think' + WILL — TAXMIN qolipi.
'will' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.
